review.notes: Full re-review. All 14 findings of the previous review (3bdb9db) are repaired; two leave residues, reported as R05 and R06. New: R01 (P2) 7.5 states 8.19.25 without Re b > 0, which DLMF also omits (divergent at p=3, b=-1/2), and 8.19.24 at a=0 as 0/0; R02 (P2) the Gibbs headline of 9.7 is statable and absent from Suggested.lean; R03 (P3) 8.15.1 is narrowed to |1-lambda|<1 and Re a>0 with a false convergence claim; R04 (P3) 8.21.4-8.21.7 are restricted to real x>0; R05 (P3) dawson_conj and fresnelC_ofReal_im close with one simp; R06 (P3) the ownership paragraph says 'under review', cites AL0.negativeEi without §AL.0.5, and gives a wrong locator. Gate rerun: every text check 0; depcheck NOT IN ORDER under the default order only; with the candidate order 237 roadmaps, 2420 edges, 0 problems. lake env lean: exit 0, 69 sorry warnings, nothing else.
